answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23175 Country: Pakistan Title: Kindly tell me is it right to read azan pray with rising hands? Question: Kindly tell me is it right to read azan pray with rising hands? Answer ID: 23175 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1263/949/H=1431) We are asked to say Azan by inserting both the forefingers in ears, in this way raising hand would be sure. If you mean something else by raising hands write it clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
